description: The REQUIRED tests (RBAC helper matrix for all four roles on BOTH a view adapter and a DRF adapter; webhook signature verification and idempotency including the concurrent-insert IntegrityError path), the React Native mobile skeleton using the binding CSRF token-echo auth sequence, and final full-suite verification + the PROJECT-LOG.md session entry. Depends on FEAT-003 (billing/finance must exist for the webhook and RBAC-enforcement-surface tests).
steps: Create apps/accounts/tests/test_permissions.py: a table-driven matrix asserting EVERY RBAC helper for all four roles (Owner/Cashier/Trainer/Member), including the self/other distinction for can_initiate_payment, can_view_attendance, and can_edit_own_profile, and that an anonymous/None user yields False for every helper. The suite must ALSO assert enforcement through BOTH adapters: a VIEW adapter test (role_required) proving a wrong-role authenticated user gets 403 and an anonymous user is redirected to LOGIN_URL, AND a DRF adapter test (a BasePermission such as CanViewFinancials/CanManageEnrollment/CanViewAttendance via APIClient) proving the same policy is enforced on a DRF endpoint (e.g. a Cashier is denied financials on both surfaces). This is the authoritative RBAC regression guard and must encode only what AGENTS.md grants (no staff-edits-others).

Create apps/billing/tests/test_webhook.py covering: (a) verify_signature — a self-generated (secret, t, body) triple with the matching HMAC passes; the signed message is byte-exact t.encode() + b'.' + raw_body; test-mode selection compares against te and live-mode against li (livemode-driven); a tampered body fails; a malformed/missing header fails. (b) idempotency/contract — valid signature + new event -> 200, payment transitions, WebhookEvent.status==PROCESSED; a DUPLICATE PROCESSED delivery -> 200 no-op with the mutator NOT called again (spy/mock on mark_payment_paid + a WebhookEvent count assertion); the CONCURRENT-INSERT IntegrityError path -> the second delivery is a 200 no-op (simulate the duplicate-insert so the except IntegrityError branch runs); UNKNOWN_PAYMENT then a retry after the Payment is created -> transitions and becomes PROCESSED (the race fix); an unrecognized event type -> 200 + IGNORED with a redelivery short-circuiting as a terminal duplicate; an INVALID signature -> 400 with NO WebhookEvent row written at all.

Create the mobile/ React Native (Expo) skeleton configured with NativeWind (Metro/Babel plugin, build-time), react-native-reusables, and lucide-react-native: package.json, App entry, babel.config.js, tailwind.config.js, and screens/MembershipScreen performing the Revision 4 BINDING auth sequence — (1) GET an ensure_csrf_cookie-decorated endpoint to receive the csrftoken cookie; (2) POST credentials to the login view echoing the token in the X-CSRFToken header with credentials:'include'; (3) GET /api/membership/me/; (4) GET /api/attendance/ — then render the member's status + attendance using a react-native-reusables card and a lucide icon. SessionAuthentication only; NO CSRF-exempt login endpoint is created. The API base URL comes from an RN env config with a localhost dev default (not hard-coded). No business logic in the app. Document the exact four-step sequence in mobile/README.md.

On the Django side, add the lightweight ensure_csrf_cookie-decorated endpoint and a session login route if not already present, wired in profit/urls.py, so the mobile sequence has real endpoints to call.

Run the full backend suite and config check offline (SQLite, no network). Record the real `python manage.py check` and `python manage.py test` output into .agents/tasks/profit-scaffold/verification.md (overwrite with the final authoritative results, keeping earlier per-FEAT notes if useful).
Append one session entry to PROJECT-LOG.md per the AGENTS.md format (append-only; never edit earlier entries; no secrets, PII, or payment details).
acceptance_criteria: `python manage.py test apps.accounts apps.billing` passes, including the RBAC matrix on BOTH a view adapter and a DRF adapter and all webhook signature/idempotency cases (duplicate no-op, concurrent-insert IntegrityError 200, UNKNOWN_PAYMENT->retry->PROCESSED, IGNORED, invalid-signature 400 with no row).
The full `python manage.py test` suite passes and `python manage.py check` exits 0 offline on Python 3.13.
mobile/README.md documents the exact GET-csrf -> POST-login -> GET /api/membership/me/ -> GET /api/attendance/ sequence; SessionAuthentication only; no CSRF-exempt login endpoint.
.agents/tasks/profit-scaffold/verification.md contains the real final check/test output and PROJECT-LOG.md has a new appended session entry with no secrets/PII/payment details.
verification: Run `python manage.py test apps.accounts apps.billing` and confirm all RBAC and webhook tests pass.
Run the full `python manage.py test` and `python manage.py check` and confirm both succeed.
Confirm verification.md and PROJECT-LOG.md are updated as specified.
findings: FEAT-004 verified on Python 3.13.14 offline (SQLite default): `python manage.py test apps.accounts apps.billing` = 44 tests OK; full `python manage.py test` = 55 tests OK; `python manage.py check` = 0 issues (0 silenced). Deliverables: (1) RBAC MATRIX apps/accounts/tests/test_permissions.py -- table-driven (list-of-tuples; SimpleNamespace role stand-ins since the pure helpers never touch the DB and SimpleNamespace is unhashable so it can't be a dict key) asserting every helper for all four roles plus anonymous/None->False, including self/other for can_initiate_payment / can_view_attendance / can_edit_own_profile (encodes ONLY the AGENTS.md grants: no staff-edits-others). Enforcement proven on BOTH adapters: VIEW adapter role_required (wrong role 403, anon 302 -> /accounts/login/?next=...) and DRF adapters CanViewFinancials/CanManageEnrollment/CanViewAttendance via APIClient against a test-only ROOT_URLCONF defined IN the test module (override_settings(ROOT_URLCONF=__name__)); a Cashier is denied financials on both surfaces. NOTE the DRF CanViewAttendance test hits the blanket has_permission path where a Member with no target is 403'd (403 is correct for that collection guard) -- distinct from api/views.MyAttendanceViewSet which deliberately uses IsAuthenticated + queryset scoping for its own-records list (FEAT-002 finding 4). (2) WEBHOOK SUITE apps/billing/tests/test_webhook.py is now the authoritative/exhaustive version (expanded the FEAT-003 smoke test, did NOT replace the file): byte-exact signature t.encode()+b'.'+raw_body, te(test)/li(live) selection, tampered/malformed/missing-header/empty-secret failures, raw-body-not-decoded; idempotency contract -- valid+new->200+PROCESSED, duplicate PROCESSED->200 no-op with mock spy proving mark_payment_paid/mark_payment_failed NOT re-called + WebhookEvent count stays 1, concurrent-insert IntegrityError path->200 no-op (patch WebhookEvent.objects.get_or_create to raise IntegrityError so the except branch re-reads a pre-seeded terminal winner), UNKNOWN_PAYMENT->retry-after-Payment-exists->PROCESSED (race fix), unrecognized type->200+IGNORED with redelivery short-circuiting as terminal duplicate, invalid signature->400 with NO WebhookEvent row. (3) SESSION-AUTH ENDPOINTS api/auth.py: csrf (GET, @ensure_csrf_cookie), login_view (POST, @require_POST), logout_view (POST). CRITICAL DESIGN DECISION -- these are PLAIN Django views, NOT DRF APIViews, because DRF SessionAuthentication only runs enforce_csrf while authenticating an already-logged-in session, so an ANONYMOUS login POST via APIView would NOT be CSRF-checked; plain views keep CsrfViewMiddleware enforcing CSRF on the login POST (the binding requirement). NO csrf_exempt anywhere; SessionAuthentication only. Wired under /api/ in api/urls.py (path auth/csrf/, auth/login/, auth/logout/) which profit/urls.py includes at path('api/', include('api.urls')). Login expects JSON {username,password}: bad creds->401, malformed body->400, non-POST->405, missing CSRF token->403. apps/accounts/tests/test_session_auth.py uses Client(enforce_csrf_checks=True) and proves the full sequence (GET csrf sets csrftoken cookie -> POST login echoing X-CSRFToken -> GET /api/membership/me/ -> GET /api/attendance/). (4) MOBILE SKELETON mobile/: Expo SDK 52 + NativeWind v4 (build-time Tailwind via metro.config withNativeWind input ./global.css and babel-preset-expo jsxImportSource + nativewind/babel preset; NO runtime CDN) + react-native-reusables + lucide-react-native. Files: package.json, app.json (expo.extra.apiBaseUrl='http://localhost:8000'), babel.config.js, metro.config.js, tailwind.config.js, global.css, index.js, App.js (imports ./global.css), config.js (reads API base URL from Expo Constants extra, localhost default, NOT hard-coded), api/client.js (the four-step sequence, credentials:'include', echoes X-CSRFToken), screens/MembershipScreen.js (runs the sequence, renders status+attendance in a react-native-reusables Card with lucide UserCircle/CalendarCheck icons; no business logic), README.md documenting the exact GET-csrf->POST-login->GET /api/membership/me/->GET /api/attendance/ sequence + SessionAuth-only + no-CSRF-exempt-login, .gitignore. The npm/Expo build was NOT run (npm shim blocked per context.json; the mobile skeleton is config+source only this pass and is not part of the backend gate). (5) verification.md appended with the real final output (44/55/0); PROJECT-LOG.md appended one session entry. Nothing in production RBAC/webhook/billing CODE was changed -- FEAT-004 added tests + the mobile skeleton + the session-auth endpoints only.
